package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bahadrdsr/aspm/internal/app"
)

type privateInput struct {
	DatabaseURL, Schema, ApplicationName, BootstrapToken, Password string
	StorageEndpoint, Bucket, Prefix, AccessKey, SecretKey          string
	EncryptionKey                                                  []byte
	ProviderEndpoint, ProviderKey, Report                          string
}

type envelope struct {
	User      app.User
	Workspace app.Workspace
	Asset     app.Asset
	Import    app.Import
	Finding   app.Finding
	Profile   app.AIProfile
	Policy    app.AIPolicy
	Grant     app.AIEgressGrant
	Items     []struct{ ID string }
}

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		_, _ = io.WriteString(os.Stderr, "published-v7 owned API seed failed; private details withheld\n")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func run() error {
	var input privateInput
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(io.LimitReader(os.Stdin, 512<<10))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if decoder.Decode(&input) != nil || !strings.HasPrefix(input.Schema, "ai_assess_") {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid owned seed input")
	}
	dbURL, err := url.Parse(input.DatabaseURL)
	if err != nil || dbURL.Hostname() != "127.0.0.1" || dbURL.User == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid owned database boundary")
	}
	endpoint, err := url.Parse(input.StorageEndpoint)
	if err != nil || endpoint.Hostname() != "127.0.0.1" || endpoint.Port() == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid owned intake boundary")
	}
	provider, err := url.Parse(input.ProviderEndpoint)
	if err != nil || provider.Scheme != "https" || provider.Hostname() != "127.0.0.1" || provider.Port() == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("invalid noncalled provider metadata")
	}
	transport := http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone()
	transport.Proxy = nil
	transport.DialContext = func(ctx context.Context, network, address string) (net.Conn, error) {
		if address != endpoint.Host {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("published seed forbids non-intake network")
		}
		return (&net.Dialer{Timeout: 3 * time.Second}).DialContext(ctx, network, address)
	}
	http.DefaultTransport = transport
	defer transport.CloseIdleConnections()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	core, err := app.Open(ctx, app.Config{DatabaseURL: input.DatabaseURL, Schema: input.Schema,
		ApplicationName: input.ApplicationName, MaxConnections: 2, BootstrapToken: input.BootstrapToken,
		IntegrationEncryptionKey: input.EncryptionKey, ManualProcessing: true, PublicOrigin: "https://ai-assessments.synthetic.invalid",
		MaxUploadBytes: 256 << 10, SessionTTL: time.Hour, LogOutput: io.Discard,
		Storage: app.StorageConfig{Endpoint: input.StorageEndpoint, Bucket: input.Bucket, Prefix: input.Prefix,
			AccessKey: input.AccessKey, SecretKey: input.SecretKey, Region: "us-east-1", Timeout: 5 * time.Second}})
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("published core construction")
	}
	defer core.Close()
	workspace := ""
	var cookie *http.Cookie
	request := func(method, route string, body any, expected int, bootstrap bool) (envelope, error) {
		data, err := json.Marshal(body)
		if err != nil {
			return envelope{}, fmt.Errorf("encode seed API")
		}
		req := httptest.NewRequest(method, "https://ai-assessments.synthetic.invalid"+route, bytes.NewReader(data)).WithContext(ctx)
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		req.Header.Set("Origin", "https://ai-assessments.synthetic.invalid")
		if workspace != "" {
			req.Header.Set("X-ASPM-Workspace-ID", workspace)
		}
		if cookie != nil {
			req.AddCookie(cookie)
		}
		if bootstrap {
			req.Header.Set("X-ASPM-Bootstrap-Token", input.BootstrapToken)
		}
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		core.Handler.ServeHTTP(response, req)
		if response.Code != expected {
			return envelope{}, fmt.Errorf("published API status differs")
		}
		var result envelope
		if json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &result) != nil {
			return result, fmt.Errorf("published API envelope")
		}
		for _, value := range response.Result().Cookies() {
			if value.Name == "aspm_session" {
				cookie = value
			}
		}
		return result, nil
	}
	enrolled, err := request("POST", "/api/v1/bootstrap", map[string]any{"workspaceName": "Actual published V7 legacy",
		"name": "Synthetic legacy admin", "email": "legacy@assessment.invalid", "password": input.Password}, 201, true)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	workspace = enrolled.Workspace.ID
	session, err := request("POST", "/api/v1/login", map[string]string{"email": "legacy@assessment.invalid", "password": input.Password}, 200, false)
	if err != nil || cookie == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("published authenticated session")
	}
	asset, err := request("POST", "/api/v1/assets", map[string]any{"name": "Published V7 owned repository", "kind": "repository",
		"environment": "test", "criticality": "medium", "tags": []string{"synthetic-legacy"}, "ownerId": session.User.ID}, 201, false)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	queued, err := request("POST", "/api/v1/imports", map[string]any{"apiVersion": app.APIVersion, "assetId": asset.Asset.ID,
		"format": "sarif", "report": input.Report, "sourceId": "published-v7-source", "scanId": "published-v7-scan",
		"scope": app.Scope{ID: "owned-repository", Revision: "1", Branch: "refs/heads/main"}, "sourceScanAt": now.Add(-time.Minute),
		"collectedAt": now, "sourceStatus": "succeeded", "scanKind": "full", "completeness": "complete"}, 202, false)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err = core.ProcessImports(ctx); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("published legitimate ingestion")
	}
	completed, err := request("GET", "/api/v1/imports/"+queued.Import.ID, nil, 200, false)
	if err != nil || completed.Import.State != "succeeded" {
		return fmt.Errorf("published intake did not complete")
	}
	work, err := request("GET", "/api/v1/work", nil, 200, false)
	if err != nil || len(work.Items) != 1 {
		return fmt.Errorf("published finding missing")
	}
	id := work.Items[0].ID
	if _, err = request("PATCH", "/api/v1/findings/"+id, map[string]any{"ownerId": session.User.ID, "workflowState": "in-progress",
		"disposition": "accepted-risk", "acceptedRiskExpiresAt": now.Add(time.Hour)}, 200, false); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err = request("POST", "/api/v1/findings/"+id+"/notes", map[string]string{"text": "Actual published-V7 human decision, never model-approved context."}, 201, false); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	profile, err := request("POST", "/api/v1/ai/profiles", map[string]any{"name": "Published V7 encrypted profile", "family": "openai",
		"endpoint": input.ProviderEndpoint, "model": "operator-selected-model", "deployment": "", "enabled": true, "structuredOutput": true, "apiKey": input.ProviderKey}, 201, false)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	policy, err := request("PATCH", "/api/v1/ai/policy", map[string]string{"mode": "approved-hosted"}, 200, false)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	grant, err := request("POST", "/api/v1/ai/grants", map[string]any{"profileId": profile.Profile.ID, "profileRevision": profile.Profile.Revision,
		"policyRevision": policy.Policy.Revision, "destination": profile.Profile.Endpoint, "task": "finding-validity",
		"dataClass": "finding-evidence", "expiresAt": now.Add(time.Hour).Format(time.RFC3339Nano)}, 201, false)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(struct {
		UserID, WorkspaceID, FindingID, ImportID, AssetID string
		Cookie                                            *http.Cookie
		Profile                                           app.AIProfile
		Policy                                            app.AIPolicy
		Grant                                             app.AIEgressGrant
	}{session.User.ID, workspace, id, completed.Import.ID, asset.Asset.ID, cookie, profile.Profile, policy.Policy, grant.Grant})
}
